points.label: Covenant setting
points.left: The expression is compact and differs sharply from the narrative scale of Noah, Abraham, or Sinai.
points.right: A priestly covenant is used as a standard against which current priestly failure is measured.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Aaron · descendants · Holy contributions · salt language · Perpetual due · Brief formula · little explanation
points.right: Levi · priests · Life · peace · Revere · instruct · turn many · Covenant ideal · corrupted priestly way

payload.posture: Numbers names an enduring priestly provision; Malachi uses remembered priestly covenant as a measure of corrupted instruction.
payload.tension: The two sources materially share covenant language or memory, while their parties, setting, action, or literary purpose remain distinct.
